pages.text: Burns anything that burns in a furnace: coal, charcoal, wood, blaze rods. $(b)40 FE/t$(), buffer 100,000 FE, gives up to 400 FE/t.
While burning, fire shows in the firebox, the flywheel on the side turns and the green lamp is on. Fuel goes in through its window or a hopper.
